title: Implement Message-ID to CID mapping store in SQLite
description:
Implement the SQLite-backed store that maps Usenet Message-IDs to IPFS CIDs and vice versa. Uses sqlx. All SQL lives in this module; no SQL elsewhere. Artifact: src/msgid_map.rs in usenet-ipfs-core with sqlx migrations in core/migrations/.

Acceptance:
- insert(message_id, cid) and lookup_by_msgid(message_id) -> Option<Cid> work correctly
- lookup_by_cid(cid) -> Option<String> works correctly
- Duplicate insert is idempotent (same CID) or returns error (different CID)
- Migration runs with `sqlx migrate run` on a fresh database
- Unit tests cover insert, lookup, duplicate, and missing-key cases
